description: Atlyn Financial Matrix presents model-authored profit-and-loss statements with Actual, Budget, and Prior measures in a structured financial table. Configure stable line IDs, captions, sibling order, row types, numeric formats, signs, and favorable direction explicitly. Currency, ordinary numbers, model-defined margins, and distinct counts can coexist without summing statement rows. Eligible lines show absolute and relative scenario differences. Margin differences are percentage points; zero-reference relative comparisons are N/A, and missing or invalid values remain distinct from zero. Named statement subtotals and matrix-provided totals remain authoritative model results. Included synthetic examples demonstrate profit and loss, balance-sheet snapshots, and a cash-flow bridge using the same presentation contract. Frozen row and period headers, vertical row windowing, local expand/collapse, keyboard navigation, high-contrast and RTL presentation, and native host identity APIs support report interaction. Local collapse affects delivered descendants only. Power BI controls native selection, tooltip, and context-menu or drillthrough behavior. Author acquisition and use require an active paid or trial Atlyn all-access subscription under the Atlyn customer terms.
